newsitem.title: USA: US Trade nominee meets with Senate leader Lott.
newsitem.headline: US Trade nominee meets with Senate leader Lott.

text.p: Charlene Barshefsky, nominee for U.S. Trade Representative, held a meeting with Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott on Monday, but left without making any comment.
"I don't have any comments to make," she said when asked about the meeting.
Lott's office declined even to confirm that Barshefsky had a meeting with the Republican from Mississippi.
Lott said on Friday that he could not predict when the Senate would vote on Barshefsky's confirmation.
The Senate Finance Committee has cleared the appointment, but Barshefsky has been hampered by questions over her work for Canadian interests when she was a trade lawyer in private practice.

Before the full Senate can take a vote, both the House and the Senate must waive a law prohibiting anyone who has represented a foreign government or foreign political party in trade negotiations from serving as U.S. Trade Representative or Deputy Trade Representative.
